# Siemens S6 Flasher

**Author:** Siemens AG<br/>
**Platforms:** x10/x25 (HIGOLD)

Siemens package for flashing the S6 phone via the serial port. Includes the update program `SP1076.EXE`, the configurator `SWUPINST.EXE`, and the port settings file.
